items.q: Russell, who Roscoe did not appear to be a very wonderful trumpet player, was on quite a lot of his records.

ctx.x: He does; but that's your opinion.
: No, but I had no reason to say that except that Russell, who Roscoe did not appear to be a very wonderful trumpet player, was on quite a lot of his records.
Well, Russell could have been much greater than what he is if he had the right support, and not been hampered by his brother. You know, you can tear a man's heart-strings out.
